stories.title: AI cancer cures slowed by chip shortage, says UK's biggest tech boss
stories.simple_summary: Companies trying to use AI to find cancer cures are slowed down because they can't get enough computer chips to run the AI programs.
stories.why_it_matters: This affects medical research, not your daily life right now, but it could delay new cancer treatments from reaching patients.

stories.title: Law Schools Outlaw AI Amid Fears of Stunted Academic Growth
stories.simple_summary: Law schools are banning students from using AI tools because they worry students won't learn proper legal thinking if they rely on AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you need a lawyer, this means they'll have learned without AI shortcuts, which could be good for the quality of legal help you receive.

stories.title: Opaque recurrence, and other AI terms that you should probably know
stories.simple_summary: An article explains confusing AI words that experts use but most people don't understand.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just educational content — nothing you need to do.

stories.title: With AI Remarks, Deming Dismisses Integrity at Harvard
stories.simple_summary: A Harvard official made comments about AI that some people think show he's not being honest or fair.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about what's happening at one university — nothing that affects you directly.

stories.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra model autonomously completes Portal in 24 hours — feat cost just $571 in tokens
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's newest AI model solved a complex video game puzzle on its own, spending only $571 in computer costs to do it.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly interests AI engineers and investors — it shows progress in the technology but won't change anything about how you'd use AI.

stories.title: Exclusive: Ineffable Intelligence adds 6 "cofounders," hiring from Google DeepMind and InstaDeep
stories.simple_summary: A small AI company is hiring experienced people from bigger tech companies like Google.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech workers — nothing you need to know about.

stories.title: Early Data Indicates an A.I.-Generated Drug Could Slow Aging
stories.simple_summary: Early tests of a drug designed by AI show it might be able to slow down aging in people.
stories.why_it_matters: If this pans out, it could mean new medical treatments down the road, but these tests are very early — don't expect anything soon.

stories.title: Malaysia Eyes Huawei Chips for AI Project Despite US Warning
stories.simple_summary: Malaysia wants to buy computer chips from a Chinese company (Huawei) to power an AI project, even though the United States is warning them not to.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a political story between countries — it doesn't affect you unless you live in Malaysia or work in tech trade.

stories.title: Breakingviews - COMMENTARY: How to make the world safer for AI
stories.simple_summary: An opinion piece discusses how to make AI safer for society.
stories.why_it_matters: This is commentary and debate — nothing specific is happening that you need to act on.

stories.title: Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft for infringement
stories.simple_summary: Two newspapers are suing OpenAI and Microsoft, saying the companies used their news articles to train AI without asking permission and the AI sometimes copies their writing.
stories.why_it_matters: This could eventually lead to rules about whether AI companies have to pay for using journalism, which could affect news you read online.

stories.title: Authors push back as publishers and agents make claims on Anthropic settlement
stories.simple_summary: Authors are arguing that publishers are taking too much of a settlement payment that Anthropic (an AI company) agreed to pay.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about how money gets divvied up between publishers and authors — it's mainly a legal and business matter.

stories.title: Travis Kalanick’s Atoms might be getting into the robotaxi business
stories.simple_summary: Uber's founder is looking at using robot taxis (self-driving cars) through a company he owns called Atoms.
stories.why_it_matters: If this happens, it could eventually mean driverless taxi services in your area, but this is still just in early exploration.
